domain_description: Analysis of railroad engineering, locomotive systems, signal and communication systems, bridge and structure assessment, freight operations, safety management, regulatory compliance, and infrastructure planning. Based on FRA regulations, AREMA Manual for Railway Engineering, AAR standards, and PTC implementation requirements.
authority_sources: FRA 49 CFR Parts 200-299 (Federal Railroad Administration Regulations)
49 CFR Part 236 (Rules, Standards, and Instructions for Signal and Train Control)
PTC Implementation Rules (49 CFR Part 236 Subpart I)
ASCE Manual of Practice for Railway Engineering
AAR Manual of Standards and Recommended Practices

engines.name: Track Engineering Engine
engines.function: Analyze railroad track design, rail profile selection, ballast specifications, crosstie spacing, curve and superelevation calculations, track geometry, and maintenance scheduling per FRA 49 CFR Part 213 and AREMA standards.
doctrine_topics: FRA track class standards and speed limits
rail profile selection and wear analysis
continuous welded rail CWR stress management
track maintenance scheduling and surfacing cycles

golden_queries.question: Design the track structure for a Class 4 main line carrying 40 MGT annually with 286,000 lb car loads, including rail weight, tie spacing, and ballast depth requirements
required_elements: rail weight selection 136 RE or heavier
annual tonnage impact on maintenance cycle

golden_queries.question: Calculate the superelevation and spiral length for a 3-degree curve on Class 4 track with 60 mph freight and 79 mph passenger traffic

engines.name: Locomotive Systems Engine
engines.function: Analyze diesel-electric and electric locomotive systems including prime mover performance, traction motor characteristics, adhesion management, dynamic braking, and locomotive consist optimization per FRA Part 229 and AAR standards.
doctrine_topics: traction motor characteristics and thermal limits
adhesion management and wheel slip control
dynamic braking performance and grid cooling
locomotive consist optimization and MU operation
locomotive air brake systems (26-L and CCB)

golden_queries.question: Determine the locomotive consist required for a 15,000-ton coal train over a 1.5% ruling grade, 200-mile route with 4400 HP AC traction units

engines.name: Signal Systems Engine
engines.function: Analyze railroad signal systems including wayside signaling, Positive Train Control PTC, communication-based train control, interlocking design, and signal maintenance per FRA 49 CFR Part 236.
doctrine_topics: track circuit design and insulated joints

golden_queries.question: Design a PTC overlay system for a 150-mile Class I railroad subdivision currently operating under CTC with wayside signals, handling both freight and Amtrak passenger service

engines.name: Bridge Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze railroad bridge structural capacity, load rating, inspection requirements, fatigue assessment, and rehabilitation planning per AREMA Chapter 15 and FRA bridge safety standards.
doctrine_topics: AREMA Cooper E loading and equivalent loads
bridge load rating normal and maximum
bridge inspection frequency and reporting FRA
movable bridge mechanical and electrical systems

golden_queries.question: Load rate a 100-year-old steel through-plate girder bridge with span of 60 feet for current 286,000 lb railcar loading, identifying critical members and remaining fatigue life

engines.name: Freight Operations Engine
engines.function: Analyze railroad freight operations including train planning, yard operations, car scheduling, intermodal logistics, and service reliability optimization per AAR standards and STB reporting.
doctrine_topics: train plan optimization and blocking strategy
classification yard hump and flat switching
train handling rules and air brake management
crew management and Hours of Service compliance
freight car loading and securement AAR rules
service metrics velocity and dwell time

golden_queries.question: Optimize the blocking plan for a classification yard handling 2,500 cars per day with 45 blocks, considering connection reliability and car velocity targets

engines.name: Safety Management Engine
engines.function: Analyze railroad safety management systems, accident investigation, risk assessment, hazard analysis, and FRA safety compliance per 49 CFR Part 270 and system safety principles.
doctrine_topics: system safety program plan FRA Part 270
risk assessment matrix and hazard analysis
FRA reportable accident and incident criteria
grade crossing safety and diagnostic analysis

golden_queries.question: Develop a risk assessment for implementing remote-controlled locomotive operations in a flat switching yard with 50 daily moves adjacent to a public highway

engines.name: Regulatory Compliance Engine
engines.function: Analyze FRA regulatory compliance requirements, audit preparation, reporting obligations, waiver processes, and enforcement actions across all 49 CFR railroad safety regulations.
doctrine_topics: hours of service law 49 CFR Part 228
FRA penalty assessment and civil penalty schedule

golden_queries.question: A railroad receives an FRA Notice of Proposed Penalty for track safety violations including wide gauge, missing rail anchors, and defective ties on Class 3 track. Outline the response strategy and remediation plan.

engines.name: Infrastructure Planning Engine
engines.function: Analyze railroad infrastructure investment planning, capacity modeling, network simulation, capital project prioritization, and long-range strategic planning per STB and ASCE methodologies.
doctrine_topics: siding and passing track spacing optimization
terminal and yard capacity expansion planning

golden_queries.question: Evaluate the capacity of a 200-mile single-track railroad subdivision with 8 sidings averaging 8,000 feet, handling 18 trains per day, and recommend infrastructure investments to increase capacity to 28 trains per day
